commands: set -euo pipefail; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch --prune origin main ui/radar-details-redesign; test "$(git rev-parse origin/ui/radar-details-redesign)" = '093b4257859abdbcc683f1620969b06195ade7a6'; echo '=== DOC FILES ==='; find docs -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.md' -print | sort

set -euo pipefail; echo '=== HEADINGS / STATUS MARKERS ==='; for f in $(find docs -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.md' | sort); do echo "--- $f"; grep -nEi '^(# |## status|status:|\*\*status|> ?status|.*superseded|.*canonical|.*closed|.*blocked|.*unblocked)' "$f" | head -n 12 || true; done

set -euo pipefail; echo '=== CROSS-REFERENCES TO PHASE 3 HANDOFFS ==='; grep -RInE 'PHASE3_(FINAL_HANDOFF|HANDOFF|FIELD_REACCEPTANCE_HANDOFF|CAPTURED_DATA_ANALYSIS_HANDOFF)' docs --include='*.md' || true; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
